note: Griggs County (ND) publishes no queryable zoning district layer. The county site lists planning/zoning services but links no zoning map or GIS service. The city of Cooperstown, the county seat, publishes its City Zoning Map only as a PDF (City_Map.pdf) on cooperstownnd.com. ArcGIS searches for zoning in Griggs County and across ND found nothing covering the county; the one zoning FeatureServer that surfaced (services.arcgis.com/f4rR7WnIfGBdVYFd) returns zero features inside the county box, so it is not Griggs zoning. Binford and Hannaford publish no zoning service found.
